name: Muriyari!? Otome Days
source:
Makoto is a boy with pure and cute looks that rival the prettiest girls. He has a complex about his looks and trains to become more manly, but has nothing to show for it. His osananajimi Kiyora asked him to help out at her family’s shrine. Since he cannot turn down a girl’s request, he ended up working there as a miko. He became popular among the shrine visitors and with Kiyora planning more things, how far will his cross-dressing go!?

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2012/04/01/april-2012-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
里見真實是一名少年，純潔可愛的容貌甚至不輸最漂亮的女孩。他一直為自己的長相感到自卑，努力鍛鍊身體，希望變得更有男子氣概，可惜始終不見成效。他的青梅竹馬津雲清流請他到自家的神社幫忙。由於無法拒絕女孩的請求，真實最終竟穿上巫女服，作為巫女開始工作。

真實很快便在神社參拜客中大受歡迎，清流似乎還準備了更多計畫。他的女裝生活究竟會發展到什麼地步？！

［引自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2012/04/01/april-2012-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]］
